dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Don't go running off now, little ones. If you're good, we can prepare some delicious food and hold a banquet for you all over at the manor...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Don't mind them, they're perfectly harmless — just so long as they don't break anything. It's just a bit of mischief that can be easily trained out of them.

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: But if they start running around and breaking things, or hurting the other animals, even upsetting the local ecosystem...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Well, that would make them an invasive species! In which case, they would need to be dealt with... mercilessly!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Uh... I guess it would need to be vegetarian...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: If they need more protein, then we can add some legumes... Cooking isn't really my forte, my experience is more with looking after prey... We could try taking them back to their natural habitat...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Oh, that reminds me. I should really do some research on how to properly feed the guests at the manor.

choices.text: Make sure to look after the animals!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: It's my duty. I'll see it through to the best of my ability!
